name: androidx.camera.featurecombinationquery.playservices.MetadataHolderService
description: When an app asks AndroidX CameraX which camera feature combinations a device supports, this Service advertises the Google Play services provider that answers the query. CameraX reads this entry while setting up the query.
disableEffect: Without this entry, devices that lack a native replacement may no longer report supported camera combinations, which can make camera modes that depend on those checks unavailable.
